title: hieracium alatum subsp. macrorhizum
intro: Hieracium alatum subsp. macrorhizum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, fighting against oxidative stress, and potentially alleviating symptoms of various health conditions. Hieracium alatum subsp. macrorhizum contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
